quests.title: Acorn Avenue Mile-Marker Errand
quests.kidDirection: Pick one window clue, add it to the errand list, and write what the acorn clerk checks first.
quests.adultNote: Give the child a clipboard or firm book, then invite quiet pointing to one outside detail before writing.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this page as the first errand slip for a small Acorn Avenue travel story.

quests.title: Button Bakery Rest Stop Route
quests.kidDirection: Draw a simple bakery path, then write three clear clues that help the button cart arrive.
quests.adultNote: Use the table time for one short map chat, then let the child finish the fill-ins at their own pace.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this route page as the map piece for a Button Bakery travel story.
materials: Small paper napkin for a crumb map

lines: Last, set the button tray on ____________________________.

quests.title: Spoon Ferry Hotel Lunchbox Log
quests.kidDirection: Choose a lunchbox cargo, label the harbor stops, and write the ferry's final note.
quests.adultNote: Set out only one pencil and two colors so the hotel desk stays simple and easy to reset.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this harbor log as the middle scene of a Spoon Ferry travel story.
materials: Folded index card for a lunchbox label

quests.title: Rain Boot Visit-Day Route Card
quests.kidDirection: Mark three puddle stops, pick a helpful boot ranger, and write the route card ending.
quests.adultNote: Let cousins or siblings each name one pretend puddle, then keep the writing page with one child at a time.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this route card as a finished Rain Boot Rangers travel page.
